<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Align the six c4–c32 MI355X Kimi-K3 AgentX scheduling cells with [InferenceX #4473](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4473), building on the existing ten-point preset from [#63552](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63552).

## Claims

- Reduce `max-num-seqs` and the corresponding even CUDA-graph captures only in `mi355x_agentx_cells` at r4/o4/o10/o16/o24/o32.
- Update provenance and the executable runbook, explain the p90-interactivity versus queueing/TTFT/E2E tradeoff, and retain real block verification for serving/evaluation.

## Validation

- `git diff --check` and `pre-commit run --files recipes/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.yaml`: passed.
- Renderer `vllm-project/recipes@0bfb0e97b2cfe5651d680a2e74d0585b5c3a2880`: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <worktree>/recipes`, and `node scripts/build-recipes-api.mjs`: passed (217 models).
- Upstream Recipes / Validate and DCO passed. The upstream pre-commit workflow is gated: `pre-run-check` found 3 merged PRs for the author, below its requirement of 4, and skipped upstream pre-commit. Local pre-commit passed; no gate labels were requested. ReadTheDocs reports a skipped build.
- Compared 22,426 generated JSON files before/after: command changes occur only in the six intended points in `moonshotai/Kimi-K3/presets/mi355x_agentx_cells.json`; generic MI355X, other presets/models and r1/o48/o52/o60 retain their command outputs. All ten points match InferenceX's resolved sequence caps, complete capture lists, draft settings, quantization and offload JSON.
- Real Chromium preview: clicked all six modified points and checked full capture lists, pinned image, topology, speculative/offload settings, and Serve/cURL/Bench model identity; all passed with no runtime exceptions.
- Executed all ten runbook branches with captured `vllm` argv/environment; Bash syntax, rendered-command parity and rejection of five invalid profile/concurrency combinations passed. This validates shell expansion, not GPU inference.
- Reused [InferenceX run 40132624130](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40132624130), source `684d891612596e4ed9dbdd2f402865e288214815`: all ten performance jobs succeeded, including [resident c4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40132624130/job/121058736967), [offload c4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40132624130/job/121058736622) and [offload c32](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40132624130/job/121058736853). These throughput runs use synthetic acceptance.
- Ten real-verification accuracy jobs cover nine distinct cells (offload c4 was not evaluated; c60 has vendor and lm-eval jobs). Downloaded native artifacts and revalidated all ten with current `infx.evals.validate_scores`: passed. Kimi schema scores range 0.97549–0.992647 (408 cases/cell; repository threshold 0.0); c60 GSM8K strict/flexible scores are 0.966641/0.965883 (1,319 cases; threshold 0.9). [Accuracy collection](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40132624130/job/121058737731).

## Details

Source snapshot: [InferenceX 8737db4e8a1fae1f2e9cd03d04f2e03d6bf90145](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/tree/8737db4e8a1fae1f2e9cd03d04f2e03d6bf90145). The source-run/current-head matrix and fully bound lane configurations match; evidence is reused from the tested source, not an exact-head GPU rerun. Current [#4473 CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40269775428) passed; its [sweep wrapper](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40269775480) passed only the changelog/reuse gates with benchmark/eval matrices skipped. No local MI355X inference run was performed. Performance collection/comparison were skipped in the unofficial source run; no universal latency or throughput gain is claimed, and earlier #4393 simulation is not presented as a #4473 measurement.

Before/after rendered values (`max-num-seqs` / graph maximum):

| Point | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| r4 | 8 / 64 | 2 / 16 |
| o4 | 8 / 48 | 2 / 12 |
| o10 | 20 / 100 | 6 / 30 |
| o16 | 32 / 160 | 10 / 50 |
| o24 | 48 / 240 | 16 / 80 |
| o32 | 64 / 320 | 24 / 120 |

Image `nightly-rocm100-df6603f0…`, target/draft identities, TP8/DCP8/A2A, target/draft/KV precision, token budgets, c1 specialized decode, fused KDA prefill, host offload allocation and generic `mi355x_agentx` are unchanged. Also correct the affected runbook's stale rolling-image and generic-Simple descriptions to match the existing preset behavior.

Live open/merged searches for InferenceX 4473, Kimi-K3 MI355X scheduling, and the exact recipe path found no overlapping PR; related Ascend/other-GPU work does not cover these six cells. AI assistance was used for implementation, evidence auditing, validation and independent golden-review; submission is at the contributor's explicit request.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
